# systeam_status_page (Resource)

Manages a public status page.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_ids` (List of Number) List of check IDs to display on the status page.
- `name` (String) Status page name.
- `organization_id` (Number) Organization ID that owns this status page.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier for the status page.

### Optional

- `custom_domain` (String) Custom domain for the status page.
- `description` (String) Status page description.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the status page is active.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the status page is publicly accessible.
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the logo to display on the status page.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Status page ID.
